xml_docs_gap.issue: Package Aspose.Slides.NET contains Aspose.Slides.xml but pipeline expects Aspose.Slides.NET.xml
xml_docs_gap.impact: xml_warning in source-of-truth proof. DllReflector still works (DLL found via endswith('.NET') fallback). XML docs missing means method parameter descriptions unavailable in catalog.
xml_docs_gap.mitigation: DLL fallback already implemented. XML docs absence is non-blocking for generation — API catalog has method signatures from reflection. LLM prompts will lack docstring context but method signatures are sufficient.

api_architecture.pattern: ALL_STATIC — all workflow root methods are static
api_architecture.compress_pattern: Compress.CompressEmbeddedFonts(Presentation pres) — takes Presentation object (in-memory), mutates in place
api_architecture.convert_pattern: Convert.ToPdf(Presentation pres, string outPath) OR Convert.ToPdf(string presPath, string outPath) — both file and in-memory overloads
api_architecture.merger_pattern: Merger.Process(string[] inputFileNames, string outputFileName) — file path array input, simplest overload
api_architecture.key_difference: Compress modifies Presentation object IN PLACE (no output path). Save Presentation after calling Compress.

fixture_strategy.approach: Create Presentation object programmatically via Aspose.Slides.Presentation. Add slides with ISlide.Shapes. Save to .pptx file.
fixture_strategy.compress_fixture_note: Compress takes Presentation object, NOT file path. Must load (or create) Presentation, call Compress static method, then save.
fixture_strategy.dependency_gap_risk: LOW — discovery succeeded; DLL and deps resolved

Compress.rationale: RemoveUnusedLayoutSlides is safest for any presentation — removes unused layout slides without visible content loss. CompressEmbeddedFonts requires embedded fonts. RemoveUnusedMasterSlides is more destructive.
Compress.fixture_note: Compress takes Presentation object, NOT file path. Load with new Presentation(path) or create programmatically.

required: REQUIRED: Compress.RemoveUnusedLayoutSlides(pres) — static call on Presentation object
REQUIRED: pres.Save(outputPath, SaveFormat.Pptx) after calling Compress — Compress mutates in-place
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: manual slide manipulation replacing Compress — use LowCode Compress static methods
FORBIDDEN: passing file path to Compress — Compress takes Presentation object, not string path

Convert.rationale: ToPdf with file-path overload: Convert.ToPdf(presPath, outPath) is the simplest — no Presentation object needed. Converts PPTX to PDF directly from file paths.

required: REQUIRED: Convert.ToPdf(presPath, outputPath) — static file-path call, simplest overload
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: Presentation.Save() replacing Convert.ToPdf() — use LowCode Convert static method

Merger.rationale: Merger.Process(string[] inputFileNames, string outputFileName) is the simplest file-path overload. Merges multiple PPTX into one.
Merger.output_validation: output .pptx file exists; size > 0; slide count >= sum of inputs
Merger.pair_fixture_strategy: programmatic_pptx_pair — same as programmatic_pptx but create 2 separate files

required: REQUIRED: Merger.Process(inputFiles, outputFile) — static file-path array call
REQUIRED: input files array with 2+ PPTX paths
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: manual slide copy/import replacing Merger.Process() — use LowCode Merger
